summary.text: Victor Muh is the Republican candidate for the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Democratic incumbent Ikaika Olds.
His career experience includes working in healthcare, and he describes himself as an entrepreneur who spent 25 years overseas.

paragraphs.text: Victor Muh's career experience includes working in healthcare.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a longtime Hawaii resident, entrepreneur and Human Optimization Engineer who spent 25 years overseas in Austria, France and China.
He advanced from the August 8, 2026 Republican primary with 436 votes, with no other candidate on the ballot.
Muh said in the survey that his campaign focuses on lowering the cost of living by rebuilding Hawaii's economy, restoring accountability in government, and improving daily life in District 23.
He also said he supports local food production, small businesses, manufacturing, reduced tax burdens, housing people can afford to own, and a line-by-line review of the state budget.
